Escape to the serene mountains and join me as I craft a GIANT village burrito completely from scratch over an open fire! 🌯🔥 From rolling ultra-thin flatbread and deep-frying hand-cut potatoes to grilling spiced chicken, every layer is packed with rich rustic flavors.Take a moment to unwind, listen to the crackle of the flames, and experience the peaceful rhythm of rural life. 🌿 If you enjoyed this cozy outdoor feast, don't forget to subscribe and join our village cooking family! ✨
